purpose: Qualify a response-independent GloBI specialization predictor by proving row-level source exclusion and remaining taxonomic support without computing specialization, partner entropy, or any turnover response.

stage_A_file_inventory.allowed_content: Zenodo record metadata and file-level metadata only: filename, size, checksum, file links, publication/version metadata.
pass_rule: identify exactly one current integrated interaction table suitable for filter-only row support audit
record exact file name, bytes, checksum and content link
interaction table must expose a stable downloadable object
stage_A_file_inventory.hold_rule: If no exact integrated interaction table is identified from record metadata, terminate HOLD without opening biological rows.

allowed_fields: dataset/source namespace or equivalent dataset identifier
source citation/reference DOI or equivalent source identifier
source taxon name/id needed only for focal-support counts
target taxon name/id needed only for partner-support counts
interaction type/class needed only to stratify support
forbidden_fields: fields not required for source exclusion or support counts

exclusion_rule.combine: exclude if namespace match OR source/citation DOI match
exclusion_rule.freeze_note: This rule is fixed before interaction rows are opened.

outputs_allowed: distinct focal taxa and partner taxa remaining by source-native interaction type
number of focal taxa meeting >=10 retained records and >=2 distinct retained partners
